text: The sun, the moon and the stars shine precisely because of the presence of darkness. In the non-manifestative — with nowhere to land — consciousness there is absolutely no darkness for them to shine forth.

The boys scatter them with their hands and feet, demolish them, dismantle them and render them unplayable. Even so, Radha, you all scatter form, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone, perception, things the mind makes, consciousness. Practise for the wanting ends.
Now that the five elements have been totally removed, the residual function of consciousness amounts to a discrimination between the three grades of pleasant-or-unpleasant tone.
With the stopping of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases to exist. That itself is the deliverance.
He declares that he has seen well in advance 'the barb on which mankind is hooked impaled'. The barb is none other than the dogmatic assertion, 'I know, I see, it is verily so'.
